scope: C1 two-chunks-in-flight proofs: test_e3_stage_overlap (CPU ring fixture), e3_alpha_c1_probe (connected CPU probe) and test_alpha_c1_box (the C1 grade over the ring fixture's own lines); no box or GPU evidence

leaves.name: fake-request-overlap-fields
leaves.replaces: vllm Request fields num_in_flight_tokens and num_prompt_tokens, and the KV manager surface the eligibility rule reads (coordinator.single_type_managers, block_pool.hash_block_size), on r4's fake request and manager
leaves.equivalence: the fields carry the values the real objects carry for a fresh, text-only, single-group request: no tokens in flight before admission, the prompt length, no hybrid group with partial hits or checkpoints, hash block 1; overlap_refusal and provisional_fields read and write exactly these, so the rule's only active clause here is successor-may-be-terminal
leaves.cannot_prove: real block allocation, prefix-cache hits, CoW and Mamba chaining under provisional fields; those run with the real KV manager in c1/alloc_diff.py and in e3_alpha_c1_probe

leaves.name: admission-every-tick
leaves.replaces: the scheduler's admission seam, which calls the controller's admit on every schedule() of an engine step
leaves.equivalence: one controller.admit(scheduler) per tick before the driver's advance, the same order as schedule() before step_with_batch_queue's driver tick; the controller alone decides (parked, successor, eligibility), as on the real seam
leaves.cannot_prove: the scheduler's other work in the same step (decode batches, stock requests); the connected probe runs the real EngineCore step

leaves.name: slow-stage-one
leaves.replaces: stage 1's workers taking longer per command than stage 0 (long layer commands on a stream shared with decode)
leaves.equivalence: stage 1's workers read the ring every sixth tick instead of every tick; device completions stay prompt, so each accepted command's report carries what has finished, the PP consumer proof among them, as each acceptance does on the box; nothing is reordered within a rank
leaves.cannot_prove: real stage timing; the per-chunk both-stages-in-flight seconds are a box receipt

leaves.name: peer-pending-injection
leaves.replaces: a worker dispatcher answering typed pending (E3Pending) under backpressure for one command while its TP peer accepted it
leaves.equivalence: rank 1's real dispatcher.submit raises the real E3Pending type for the named command a bounded number of times, then calls the real submit; the bridge turns it into the same pending SegmentAcceptance the real path sends; rank 0 is untouched
leaves.cannot_prove: when a real dispatcher answers pending on the box; reach is not established

leaves.name: probe-cpu-worker-driver
leaves.replaces: the overlap driver class the startup installs, given C0's CPU-worker composition beneath it
leaves.equivalence: the real OverlapSegmentDriver is patched by a subclass that adds nothing, so the parent's CPU-worker driver methods resolve beneath it exactly as C0's probe does under StagedSegmentDriver; ring_has_headroom is C0's declared leaf, unchanged
leaves.cannot_prove: a device stream, a real QSA layer and a real collective, as C0

leaves.name: one-engine-numbering
leaves.replaces: one engine process serving every arm: one reply transport and one engine progress trace for the incarnation's life
leaves.equivalence: each arm's stack starts its transport's command sequence and its engine trace's line number where the previous arm's ended, so sequences and engine line numbers are unique and gap-free over the run, as on the box; the worker traces are one object per rank across arms, as the worker processes are; nothing else of the stack is carried
leaves.cannot_prove: transaction numbers continuing across arms (each stack's controller starts at 1; the grade reads transactions per arm span only), and state left by one request for the next

leaves.name: decode-live-count
leaves.replaces: NativeSegmentDriver._progress_decode_live, the count of running requests past their prompt, read only into the progress line's identity at progress.begin
leaves.equivalence: returns 8 for every chunk of a live arm and 8 then 0 for a solo arm, the counts the box's standing decoders give; the value is written into the identity and read by nothing that decides (two callers, both writing the identity at progress.begin: engine_driver._begin and stage_overlap._reset for the successor's line)
leaves.cannot_prove: decoders actually running beside the prefill; the ring fixture has no decode batch

leaves.name: fake-cuda-allocator
leaves.replaces: torch.cuda as read by worker_bridge.memory_receipt: is_initialized, memory_stats, mem_get_info
leaves.equivalence: memory_receipt reads exactly these three host queries and nothing else; the bridge's own _memory_receipt builds and logs the real line at the real open and released points (FLASH_S5_AUTO_ARM=1 sets _memory_receipts at construction; set here directly), so the grade reads the emitter's own text; values are constant per selection
leaves.cannot_prove: real allocator behaviour, transient peaks, retries or OOMs; the damaged-receipt cases edit these lines the way the box log can

leaves.name: selection-by-attribute
leaves.replaces: the typed native_stage_local {local, overlap} control, which sets the same two driver attributes when the engine is paused idle FULL
leaves.equivalence: the control's only effect on the chunk path is these two attributes (stage_overlap._stage_control, stage_progress._stage_control); the stack is built with its request admitted, so the paused-idle condition cannot hold; the control itself runs through the real router, session and client in test_e3_stage_overlap_control and the arm's release in test_alpha_c1_box.Selection
leaves.cannot_prove: the control's paused-idle refusal on a running engine

leaves.name: arm-record-box-fields
leaves.replaces: the client-side fields of a box arm record: TTFT, client rates, decode windows, append, metrics, sampled outputs
leaves.equivalence: the grade reads them only for the performance table and the numerics comparison, which test_alpha_c0_queue covers on the same shapes (q0.outputs, synthetic_run's fields); the selection, status deltas (the driver's own stage_status through the grade's stage_view and stage_delta), wall spans and chunk counts are the run's own
leaves.cannot_prove: client timing or token values; those are box receipts
